steps: Follow the privacy-rights link published in this brand’s own current homepage footer.
Review the separate tools and their scope in the delegated Intelius privacy center. A delegated link is not proof of complete brand-record suppression.

optout.notes: PeopleConnect lists Intelius, TruthFinder, US Search and Instant Checkmate as its brands, and the 2026 California registry lists ZabaSearch and Addresses.com under Intelius, LLC. The PeopleConnect suppression center says it covers name-search results on the people search sites in the PeopleConnect family, not Classmates. No separate ZabaSearch opt-out URL was found in MIT prior art, and zabasearch.com was bot-blocked.
